title: DataspaceProtocolTransferStartMessage
description:
Interface for Dataspace Protocol Transfer Messages.
https://eclipse-dataspace-protocol-base.github.io/DataspaceProtocol/#transfer-start-message

consumerPid.description: MUST refer to the transfer identifier of the Consumer side.

providerPid.description: MUST refer to the transfer identifier of the Provider side.

dataAddress.description:
MUST be provided if the current transfer is a pull transfer and
contains a transport-specific endpoint address for obtaining the data.
